author: opencode-worker-2
text: Concrete 4.1.0 build instances from attempting 5fva.1 (ping_l2) on heft against the 4.1.0 workspace: (1) lora_loopback recv_async 3-arg callback vs 4.1.0 API (0l5j scope, errors lora_loopback.c:239/301); (2) coap_client.c send_mutex removed upstream (new bead). Environment note: the workspace was missing the manifest-imported tinycrypt project (modules/crypto/tinycrypt not cloned) which made every LICHEN Kconfig select TINYCRYPT abort configuration with Kconfig warnings-as-errors; tinycrypt is now cloned at the manifest pin 1012a3eb and must be passed via ZEPHYR_EXTRA_MODULES alongside the lichen module (west update tinycrypt alone is refused for import-resolved projects). After those two code fixes ping_l2 should configure+build; the three runtime -ENOENT failures (5fva children) remain to be debugged.
